class.name: MaszynaFizManager
class.brief_description: The vehicles' FIZ files as their descriptions, each read once.
class.description: A [code].fiz[/code] read into its vehicle's description - a [VehicleController] with its components, which a vehicle is built of a copy of - and kept on disk: a scenery repeats the same file across many trainset entries, and parsing it is the expensive part. An entry is read again when its file changes (its modification time - an included file's is not seen) or the reader's format does. The reader is the FIZ parser, handed in by the plugin's runtime ([method set_description_reader]).

method.name: load_description
method.description: Returns the vehicle the [code].fiz[/code] of [param data_path]/[param fiz_filename] in the game's data describes.

method.name: load_description_at
method.description: Returns the vehicle the [code].fiz[/code] at [param fiz_path] describes; null without a reader.

method.name: set_description_reader
method.description: Sets what reads a [code].fiz[/code] into its description - [code](fiz_path: String) -> VehicleController[/code] - and [param format_version], the version of what it builds, raised whenever the parser changes it.
